headline: Tigresses return home empty-handed after losing to Pakistan
summary: For the first time in Asian Games history, the Bangladesh women's cricket team finishes the tournament without a medal.
details: The Bangladesh women's cricket team suffered a 31-run defeat against Pakistan in the bronze medal deciding match of the 2026 Asian Games on Tuesday.

Chasing a target of 146, Bangladesh struggled early, losing three quick wickets to be reduced to 20-3. Nigar Sultana Joty and Sharmin Akhter attempted a recovery with a 47-run partnership for the fourth wicket.

Nigar Sultana Joty, playing her final match as skipper, was dismissed for 25 off 30 balls. Sharmin Akhter remained unbeaten on 45 off 46 balls, but the slow batting pace pushed the required run rate to nearly 11.
Bangladesh finished their 20 overs at 114-7, failing to reach the target. Pakistan's off-spinner Umm-e-Hani claimed three wickets to stifle the chase.
Earlier, Pakistan posted a total of 145-8. Skipper Fatima Sana led the way with a brilliant 45 off 30 balls, sharing a 67-run stand with Aliya Riaz.
Bangladesh's bowling effort was led by Nahida, Shorna Akter, and Ritu Moni, who each took two wickets.
This marks the first time the Tigresses have returned from an Asian Games campaign without a medal, having previously won two silver and one bronze in 2010, 2014, and 2023 respectively.
caption:

topic: MP Gazi Nazrul's wife laid to rest amid controversy
headline_marked: MP Gazi Nazrul's second wife [[Mariam laid to rest]] in Satkhira
headline: MP Gazi Nazrul's second wife Mariam laid to rest in Satkhira
summary: The burial took place at midnight in the family graveyard, while the MP is now in remand over abetment of her death.
details: Mariam Khatun, the second wife of Member of Parliament Gazi Nazrul Islam, was buried at midnight in a family graveyard in Satkhira.
The burial occurred amidst demands for justice from her relatives, who are seeking a full investigation into the circumstances of her death.
Meanwhile, MP Gazi Nazrul Islam has been taken into remand by law enforcement agencies as part of the investigation into the abetment of her death.
The case has drawn significant attention due to the involvement of a sitting member of parliament and the allegations surrounding the death of his spouse.
caption:
Buried at midnight, Mariam Khatun's death sparks demands for justice as her husband, MP Gazi Nazrul, is taken into remand.

Mariam Khatun, the second wife of Member of Parliament Gazi Nazrul Islam, was buried at midnight in a family graveyard in Satkhira.

The burial occurred amidst demands for justice from her relatives, who are seeking a full investigation into the circumstances of her death.

Meanwhile, MP Gazi Nazrul Islam has been taken into remand by law enforcement agencies as part of the investigation into the abetment of her death.

The case has drawn significant attention due to the involvement of a sitting member of parliament and the allegations surrounding the death of his spouse.
